thread:
Ravi S: Hey team  first day remote. Received my laptop and monitor but the USB-Ethernet dongle in the box doesn't seem to work. Mac shows the adapter as connected but no network traffic. I can see RedwoodGuest WiFi but not RedwoodCorp. Opening INC-9921. Anyone seen this?

Marta (IT): Welcome Ravi! Sorry you're hitting this on day 1. Can you check System Settings > Network and tell me if the adapter shows up and whether it has an IP? Also what's the dongle model (label on it)?

Ravi S: Adapter shows up as "USB 10/100/1000 LAN" but says "No IP Address". Label reads "NetLink-UG3". I tried unplugging/replugging and different USB-C port on the laptop.

Marta (IT): OK. Two quick checks: (1) do you have any VPN software installed that might block DHCP? (2) try renewing DHCP via terminal with:
```bash
sudo ipconfig set en6 DHCP  # use the interface name shown in Network settings
```
If you get an error paste it here.

Ravi S: No VPN yet. Ran the command; it prompts for my password then says "DHCP failed: no response from server".

Marta (IT): That suggests the dongle isn't negotiating with your home router. We'll do a swap. I'll schedule a same-day courier with a test dongle and spare power cable. Could you confirm whether home router blocks unfamiliar MACs (some ISPs do)?

Ravi S: I don't think so but not sure. My ISP is Spectrum. Happy to try the replacement. Also the monitor arrived with a DisplayPort cable but my dock only has HDMI, will the courier bring an HDMI cable too?

asset-bot: Asset INC-9921 created; awaiting asset-tag assignment for loaner dongle.

Marta (IT): Yes I'll add an HDMI cable and a TB3 test adapter to the courier. If the replacement dongle also fails we'll swap the dock.

Alexa - People Ops: Welcome @Ravi S :tada: If the courier needs a signature we have the home address you provided. LMK if you'd rather pick up at the nearest Redwood hub.

Ravi S: Home pickup is fine. Quick question: while waiting for courier can someone enable temporary access from RedwoodGuest so I can finish okta signups? Guest blocks the SSO popup sometimes.

Marta (IT): We can add a temporary exception for the guest SSID for your device MAC for 2 hours. Please paste your adapter MAC (from Network settings) when you have it.

Ravi S: MAC is 7C:8B:CA:11:22:33. Thanks!

it-bot: INC-9921 state updated to "in_progress" by Marta (IT)

Marta (IT): Temporary exception applied for 2 hours. Courier scheduled for tomorrow 09:00-13:00. I'll follow up here after swap. :thumbsup:

Ravi S: Thanks so much! Appreciate the quick help  excited to get started.
